commit_b.message: fix: freeze block1 risk and execution safety
commit_b.scope: risk-domain/execution hardening: NBF-3, NBF-4, NBF-5, NBF-6, NBF-7
commit_b.note: core/decision_adapter.py included only the NBF-6 enum-authenticity fix and its supporting risk-level absence/unsupported normalization (RISK_KEYS, ABSENT_RISK_LEVEL, UNSUPPORTED_RISK_LEVEL, get_risk_level, get_raw_risk_level, delegation to execution_models.normalize_risk). The unrelated Phase-5 _resolve_phase5_metadata collision-handling logic in the same file was deliberately excluded and remains uncommitted in the working tree. Isolation was verified empirically: the committed hunk alone passes 465/465 relevant NB/NBF tests; the initial attempt to isolate only the enum-duck-typing removal failed 35/50 NBF-6 tests and was corrected before commit.

pytest_basetemp_caveat: Windows account name contains a non-ASCII character (HUAWEİ), which breaks pytest's default tmp path handling; an explicit ASCII --basetemp is required.
result_context: Full suite run against the post-commit working tree, which still carries the unrelated Phase-5 metadata-collision work (uncommitted) and other pre-existing unrelated dirty/staged state - not an isolated clean checkout of only the freeze commits.

block2_entry_conditions.M-1: Reservation/admission leak: risk admission reserves capital before some later compatibility gates; a subsequent POSITION_LIMIT/CAPITAL_RISK_* rejection can leave a stale capital reservation and stale _risk_admissions. Currently dormant/conservative in the current application composition. Must be fixed before canonical risk services are wired into core/application.py.
block2_entry_conditions.M-2: Evidence-removal monotonicity: AgentFusion.fuse can produce higher confidence after removing a dissenting participant (verified example: 0.6894 -> 0.7000). Currently dormant because only two evidence participants exist while minimum participation is three. Must be fixed before a third evidence provider becomes live.

unrelated_state_note: Staged quarantine renames (19 core/*.bak -> _quarantine/phase1/core/* files, documented separately in reports/phase1_quarantine_execution/quarantine_execution_manifest.json) and the pure rename of test_decision_adapter.py -> tests/test_decision_adapter.py remain staged but outside both freeze commits. dashboard/app.py, tests/legacy_test_inventory.json, and tests/test_runtime_distribution_boundary.py (unstaged, module-boundary/quarantine-remediation related) and the Phase-5 metadata-collision work in core/decision_adapter.py and tests/test_decision_adapter.py (unstaged) are also unrelated to Block-1 and were left untouched.
